name: Scenario 1: Fast Approaching Vehicle (Urban Intersection)
description: Car approaches with increasing speed. Focus: High Risk, low TTC, urgent warning.

ground_truth.ideal_warning_frame_3: Stop immediately. A car is approaching fast, directly ahead.

name: Scenario 2: Static Obstacle with Intermittent Noise
description: Persistent static pole + single frame noises (false positives). Focus: Temporal and confidence filtering.

ground_truth.ideal_warning_frame_3: Caution, there is a pole blocking your path just ahead.

name: Scenario 3: Cyclist Cutting Across Path (Bike Lane Crossing)
description: A cyclist emerges from a bike lane and cuts perpendicularly across the pedestrian path. Focus: Lateral approach detection and collision course warning.

ground_truth.ideal_warning_frame_3: Warning! A cyclist is crossing your path from the left. Stop now.

name: Scenario 4: Open Manhole / Ground-Level Hazard
description: User approaches an uncovered manhole on the sidewalk. Object is static and low-confidence at first. Focus: Ground hazard detection at close range.

ground_truth.ideal_warning_frame_3: Danger! There is an open hole in the ground directly ahead. Stop walking.

name: Scenario 5: Multi-Object Scene – Busy Market Area
description: Crowded scene with multiple pedestrians, a dog, and a stall blocking the path. Focus: Priority ranking among many simultaneous detections.

ground_truth.ideal_warning_frame_3: Caution, the path ahead is blocked by a market stall. Multiple people and a dog are also nearby.

name: Scenario 6: Reversing Vehicle in Parking Lot
description: A car reverses slowly from a parking spot directly toward the user. Focus: Slow-speed reversing hazard detection.

ground_truth.ideal_warning_frame_3: Warning! A car is reversing towards you. Move aside immediately.

name: Scenario 7: Low-Speed E-Scooter Approach from Behind
description: An e-scooter silently approaches from behind-right. Focus: Rear/lateral silent micro-mobility hazard.

ground_truth.ideal_warning_frame_3: Caution! An e-scooter is coming from behind on your right. Step aside.

name: Scenario 8: Wet Floor Sign / Temporary Indoor Obstacle
description: User walks through a shopping mall. A wet-floor sign appears mid-aisle with low initial confidence. Focus: Low-confidence static hazard escalation.

ground_truth.ideal_warning_frame_3: Caution! There is a wet floor sign ahead. Watch your step.

name: Scenario 9: Clear Path – No Hazard (True Negative)
description: Open sidewalk with no obstacles detected across all frames. Focus: False-positive suppression and no unnecessary warnings.

name: Scenario 10: Dog On Leash – Low Risk Passthrough
description: A dog on a leash is to the user's right, moving away. Owner is visible. Focus: Low-risk classification and avoidance of unnecessary warning.

ground_truth.ideal_warning_frame_3: A dog is nearby on your right, but moving away.

name: Scenario 11: Road Crossing – Traffic Light Scenario
description: User is at a pedestrian crossing. A vehicle is stationary at red, then starts moving as light changes. Focus: Transitional risk from stationary to dynamic.

ground_truth.ideal_warning_frame_3: Warning! A car ahead is starting to move. Wait before crossing.

name: Scenario 12: Construction Zone – Multiple Barriers
description: User approaches a construction zone with temporary fencing, a traffic cone, and a construction worker. Focus: Multi-static obstacle scene with person.

ground_truth.ideal_warning_frame_3: Caution! Construction zone ahead. There is fencing blocking the path and a worker nearby. Take an alternate route.

name: Scenario 13: Transient Ghost Detection (Pure Noise)
description: High-confidence detection appears in only one frame with no continuation. Focus: Single-frame artifact/ghost detection suppression.

name: Scenario 14: Staircase Descent Hazard
description: User unknowingly approaches the edge of a descending staircase. Focus: Ground-level drop-off hazard detection.

ground_truth.ideal_warning_frame_3: Warning! Stairs descending ahead. Step carefully.

name: Scenario 15: Pedestrian Running Into Path
description: A pedestrian is jogging on a perpendicular path and is set to cross directly in front of the user. Focus: Fast-moving lateral person detection.

ground_truth.ideal_warning_frame_3: Stop! A person is running across your path from the right.

name: Scenario 16: Night Scene – Low Visibility, Motorcycle Approaching
description: Night-time scenario with a motorcycle approaching fast. Detections have lower confidence due to poor lighting. Focus: High-speed night hazard with degraded confidence.

ground_truth.ideal_warning_frame_3: Danger! A motorcycle is approaching fast in low visibility. Get off the road immediately.

name: Scenario 17: Overhanging Branch / Head-Level Obstacle
description: A low-hanging tree branch is detected at head level as user approaches. Focus: Above-waist static obstacle warning.

ground_truth.ideal_warning_frame_3: Caution! Low branch ahead at head level. Duck or step aside.

name: Scenario 18: Bus Pulling Out from Stop
description: A large bus pulls out from a bus stop directly into the user's path. Focus: Large vehicle sudden motion from stationary to dynamic.

ground_truth.ideal_warning_frame_3: Stop! A bus is pulling out from the stop into your path.

name: Scenario 19: Rain – Degraded Detection Quality
description: Heavy rain causes multiple noisy, low-confidence detections. Only a stationary van is real. Focus: Robust hazard extraction under degraded sensor conditions.

ground_truth.ideal_warning_frame_3: Caution! A van is blocking the pavement ahead.

name: Scenario 20: Grocery Cart Left Unattended on Ramp
description: A shopping cart is left on an accessible ramp, blocking the user's descent. Static obstacle on sloped surface. Focus: Low-speed, sloped-terrain static obstacle.

ground_truth.ideal_warning_frame_3: Caution! A shopping cart is blocking the ramp directly ahead.
